itineraries.title: Five days from Rhodes to Symi
itineraries.intro: Rhodes, Lindos and the amphitheatre harbour of Symi.

days.note: Board at Mandraki; the walled city.
The acropolis and St Paul’s Bay.
The pastel harbour and the deserted village beneath the castle.
The neoclassical harbour and the monastery of Panormitis on the south coast.
The walled medieval town and the Street of the Knights; board in the evening.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Rhodes to Bodrum
itineraries.intro: The Dodecanese trace the Turkish coast; crossings short enough for a swim between islands.

days.note: The walled medieval town and the Street of the Knights; board in the evening.
The neoclassical harbour and the monastery of Panormitis on the south coast.
A quiet island of walking paths, with a swim at Eristos.
The volcano’s crater floor and the white village of Mandraki.
The Asklepion and the castle by the harbour; a swim at Kefalos.
The sponge divers’ island; Vathy’s fjord and the climbing crags.
The Crusader castle and the museum of underwater archaeology.
